newsitem.title: CANADA: J.P. Morgan starts TrizecHahn as buy.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan starts TrizecHahn as buy.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said on Tuesday that it initiated coverage of TrizecHahn Corp with a buy rating.
The brokerage firm set a 12-month price target on the stock of US$25.
The Toronto-based real estate company, which is listed in Toronto, Montreal and New York, closed unchanged at 21 3/4 in New York Stock Exchange trading of more than 115,000 shares.

In recommending a buy rating, J.P. Morgan noted TrizecHahn has undertaken a number of initiatives aimed at boosting its cash flow. The brokerage expects the initiatives, which include aggressive acquisition of office assets, will lead to real estate cash flow growth in excess of 20 percent a year.
J.P. Morgan noted it has acted a co- or lead-manager of an offering of securities for TrizecHahn in the past three years.
Since it was formed by a merger of Horsham Corp and Trizec Corp Ltd last year, TrizecHahn has become one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate firms.
